note: Adapted from the original English description of Krishna & Emerson 1962 (new species; type locality Yigo, Guam; holotype the only known soldier, 1 specimen). The original does not describe the alate or the worker. Measurements are translated verbatim from Table 1 of the original, in millimetres.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Closely related to G. xantholabrum Hill, differing in the almost parallel sides of the head, the more constricted posterior half of the postmentum and the convex lateral margins of the pronotum. It differs from G. lighti in the steeper and slightly concave frontal slope, the shorter mandibles with a slightly raised outer base and a slightly wavy outer margin, and the narrower pronotum with a deeply concave anterior margin, convex lateral margins narrowing posteriorly and rounded posterolateral corners.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head pale yellowish brown, yellow behind the frontal slope, brown in the postclypeus and in the region above the antennal sockets; labrum yellowish brown; mandibles shining, dark brown, paler at the base; antennae dark yellow; pronotum dark yellow with brown patches, the margins brown; legs and tergites pale yellow. Head with a few scattered erect setae; pronotal margins and disc with short erect setae; labrum with 7—9 setae. Head small, the sides almost parallel at the middle and slightly narrowing anteriorly; anterior dorsal swellings indistinct; frontal surface of the slope slightly concave; the frontal slope about 50° in lateral view. Mandibles short, the outer base slightly raised, the outer margin slightly wavy, evenly curving outwards towards the apex; left mandible with 3 marginal teeth, the 1st and 2nd close together, the posterior edge of the 2nd and the anterior edge of the 3rd forming a concave cutting edge; right mandible with 2 marginal teeth, the tip of the 1st marginal tooth 0.23 mm from the apical tooth. Antennae 11-segmented, segment 2 longer than segment 3, segment 3 about as long as segment 4. Pronotum narrower than the head; anterior margin concave; lateral margins convex; posterior margin slightly emarginate in the middle. Femora slender. Measurements (mm; holotype soldier): head length (to the lateral base of the mandibles) 1.35; head width 0.98; head height 0.86; left mandible length 0.60; postmentum maximum width 0.38, minimum width 0.15, length 0.90; pronotal median length 0.47, maximum length 0.60, width 0.90; hind tibia length 0.68.
